name: Nora
description:
Nora is a lovely 7 year old, female, Norwich Terrier we are looking to rehome. She's friendly to people, but like most terriers, she can be scrappy with other female dogs of her size. She would get along fine with a larger dog or a male dog. 
Nora is spayed and vaccinated. She is missing 2 toes on her left rear leg as a result of getting a string wrapped around it when she was young. They required amputation. But, she's adjusted well and gets around fine. With a typical haircut, the hair covers the feet so this isn't obvious and doesn't affect her appearance.
She is accustomed to being able to get out into a fenced yard at will via a doggy door. Her adopter will need to be willing to work with her housebreaking skills if you don't have one in your home environment. Having a fenced area and time and patience to help her make this adjustment will be helpful during this process. She lives on one level so would also need to be trained to do steps if needed.

This is a referral listing to help her get a good home. She is located out of state ( she is not located in NJ) and any interested applicants would need to be willing to travel for adoption. Her adoption fee is $350 to cover her spay and vaccine costs. NO AKC papers are given with adoptions.

If you are interested or have any questions, please contact Erica Cerny at ecerny@optonline.net or 973-361-6790. More information and pictures will be posted shortly.

name: XP Monster (located in Keyport)
description:
This is Monster! She is not part of our rescue but she is listed as a courtesy for her owners who are looking for a new home for her.

Monster is a super loving, sweet girl who loves cuddling - she'd be the perfect companion for those cold winter nights which are surely on their way! Her favorite thing to do is run laps around the backyard and play with tennis balls. She especially loves to do that in the winter time in the snow.

Monster is a 7-year-old Shepherd mix who weighs 55 pounds. She is spayed & is up to date on her shots. She has been in her current home for the past 3 years but recently she has started scuffling with the other female in the home. She loves people but should go to a home where the kids are older plus she is not a fan of cats.

If you're interested in adopting her, please contact her owner directly. Kaitlin at 973 567 1586 or by emailing metalkatart@gmail.com - Monster is currently located in Keyport, NJ.

name: XP Sassy - Montclair, NJ
description:
Sassy is a beautiful 35 pound Pit Bull mix who is around 2 years old. She loves to play fetch with a tennis ball and is extremely loyal to her owners/family. She has nipped strangers though but has not hurt anyone.

We are heartbroken that we cannot keep her in a very busy household with many guests in and out each day. She would do best in a home where she has much room to run and frolic. She is a very loving & loyal dog to those who love her. As you can see in her photos, Sassy gets along with cats but can be picky about her doggy friends.

Sassy is NOT with Eleventh Hour Rescue but we are helping her owners with the rehoming process. If you are interested in meeting Sassy, please contact Jennifer directly at jmburke112@gmail.com - she is currently located in Montclair, NJ.

name: XP Ace & Buddha - Iselin, NJ
description:
Ace and Buddha are looking for new places to live - they do not have to go to the same home. Ace is brindle & white while Buddha is the blue nose Pit Bull Both dogs are under a year old & are neutered. They have basic training and are crate trained, too. They are currently located in Iselin, NJ.

Ace and Buddha are NOT with 11th Hour Rescue but we are helping with the rehoming process. If you would like to meet these dogs, please contact Diane by email at diana.doyle2116@icloud.com

name: XP Louie - Morris County, NJ
description:
At 13 years of age, Louie finds himself looking for a new place to live. He is a purebred Beagle who likes company & is a friendly companion. His owners tell us that he is in good health overall but at his age he is slightly incontinent. If you like sweet senior dogs, please consider giving Louie a place to live out his days, feeling secure and loved.

Louie is not with Eleventh Hour Rescue but we are helping his owner with the rehoming process. If you would like to meet Louie, please contact Laura at 201-694-2797. Louie is currently located in the Morris County area of NJ.

name: XP Jasmine - Randolph, NJ
description:
Jasmine is a loving, snuggly girl who loves long walks and going for car rides but she's also very happy just relaxing with her humans. She is a good listener & learns quickly. She will sit, stay and is eager to give her paws to anyone who asks! She loves belly rubs, neck/shoulder massages and will give you many kisses in return. If you're looking for a sweet, affectionate girl who will love you to bits, please take a second look at Jasmine.

Jasmine is 8 years young & currently weighs about 50 pounds. She would do best in a mellow atmosphere with no other pets and no small children. She does not do well with dogs (or humans) who are high strung, barky & aggressive. Her perfect home would be one where she was the only \"princess\" in her castle.

Jasmine thrives on receiving attention and only wants to please and love her humans any chance she gets. Jasmine is housetrained & up to date on her shots.

Jasmine is NOT with Eleventh Hour Rescue - she is a \"courtesy post\" which means that they are helping her owners with the rehoming process. She is currently located in Randolph, NJ.

If you are interested in Jasmine, please contact Joanie at pookiepalch@optonline.net or 973-641-0471 for more information and to schedule a meet & greet.

name: ABBEY
description:
Abbey is a gorgeous 5-year-old greyhound mix who came into her home at 5 months of age. She was raised with many dogs around, but as sheâs matured her desire to have other dogs around has diminished. We are trying to find Abbey a home where she will get undivided attention and have her humans to herself.  She is a bit aloof when meeting new people but as long as people let her get to know them on her terms she settles in nicely. Sheâs extremely loving with her people, enjoys snuggling and gives gentle kisses often, but doesnât do well with active or small children. She walks extremely well on a leash, and while she gets slightly reactive when she sees other dogs during walks, she can easily be re-directed with treats and praise. Abbey is an independent player, and if given a rope-toy or a bone sheâll play all by herself for quite some timeâ¦ for some reason she plays best with these items if a person she enjoys is watching her. She loves to run, and is extremely fast, so a fenced-in yard is necessary. Being a greyhound mix, she shouldnât be with any small animals (namely cats, rodents, etc.). Sheâs very vocal, and makes strange howling sounds, but when sheâs relaxed she doesnât make a peep. She does love her crate, and will settle into it nicely. Abbey is totally vetted and ready and waiting for a single pup home.
Please contact us at allstarpets@comcast.net if you would like to meet this stunning lady. She is located in North Plainfield, NJ.

name: Star
description:
Mama Star was the best mama to her 5 gorgeous babies!! Now it's her turn to find furever!! She is ready to be adopted so please apply here today at www.nybullycrew.org
Saved from the Newark Shelter in NJ, Star is so very sweet and did absolutely amazing in foster with our rockstar Foster Fam of Jenn and Jay. 
She is about 5 years old and she loves everyone she meets. According to her former foster mom Jenn, Star does not mind small dogs at all but is definitely not a fan of cats or birds. We would do proper intro and Pack walk if you have other dogs wth an approved application. She is loving, loyal, well mannered and gorgeous inside and out. She walks like a dream on leash and is housebroken as well.
Star is so deserving of a family and home to call her own. So many times we have seen mama get passed over and the puppies come and go while mama sits and waits. If you or anyone you know is looking to adopt a new best friend, we can promise you that Star would be a perfect choice!! Apply today to adopt this gorgeous brindle mama girl!!

name: Freddie
description: You can fill out an adoption application online on our official website.Fred is a shy boy from NM in a rural area so he did not meet many new people or dogs. He had cherry eye which we lasered out so he now can see well and it opened up a whole new world for him. Fred did well in his foster in NM but tends to be more shy with men so he needs time to learn to warm up otherwise he will just avoid. Once he knows you he is a whole different dog he loves to play and just be by your side. He is a quiet dog and would be fine with kids that are quieter and respectful of animals. Older kids are best as younger toddlers screaming and crying kids would startle him. He is fine with small dogs and would do awesome with a confident female dog

name: Ryder
description: Ryder is your guy! He is approximately 2 years old and a Golden Retriever/Border Collie/Heeler mix-best guess. He is a beautiful strawberry blond and has a long lean body with a docked tail. He loves being part of a pack and gets along well with other dogs. He was found as a stray from the Ute reservation in Cortez, NM, and is so glad he caught his freedom ride to Colorado. This smart goofy guy rides well in the car and hopes to become your favorite adventure buddy. He can be a little reserved at first, but once he becomes comfortable, he is affectionate and enjoys shadowing your every move. Ryder is housebroken and does well in his crate, although he prefers to be outside or free roam in the house. He is learning how to live in a house and once he masters his leash skills, he will make an awesome running buddy. Ryder is UTD on shots, neutered, and microchipped. He will do best with an active home, and someone that will be willing to continue his training. He would love a home with a companion dog, and older kids would suit him fine.Ryder is being fostered in Littleton. Want to meet Ryder and fall in love? Apply to adopt at rezdawgrescue.org

name: Bandit
description:
Meet BANDIT! 
This adorable 12 week old Shepherd Mix that is looking for his Second Chance. Bandit was rescued from a reservation in NM with his brother Legend. This is his first time enjoying the comfort and pleasures of living in a home???
Bandit is a complete sweetheart. He loves cuddling and getting affection, playing with toys, running around, and giving kisses. Bandit is working on crate training and potty training. He is such a smart boy, he is practicing âsitâ and learning ânoâ, as well as working on other basic commands. Bandit will be neutered, vaccinated and microchipped prior to adoption. 
If youâre interested in adopting Bandit, please fill out an adoption application on Do Over Dogsâ website, & feel free to message with any questions! www.DoOverDogs.com ?
Do Over Dogs is a 501c3 nonprofit animal rescue?

name: Beau
description:
0919425 -Beau is a 3 mo old lab mix. He is doing great on his potty training, loves other dogs, is crate trained, and a great puppy! He arrived here from Roswell, NM . He has been neutered and up to date on his shots. To meet Beau please fill out the adoption application
www.sloppykisses.org/adoptions

name: Simon
description:
Simon says Come Take me home. He is a super happy boy who is about 8 months old and is ready to love his very own family. We brought Simon in from a high kill shelter in NM where he was set to die. Simon lives in a foster home with other dogs and he is very active and playful. He is house trained and kennel trained. He is currently learning how to walk on a leash and loves riding in a car. Simon is a wonderful boy who will make a great addition to any family. Since he has such a good temperment we are saying he will be good with children as long as they are nice to him. He is non-reactive to cats while in his kennel but has not really been tested. Simon has such a good natured personality we know he can learn to live with anything - he is that wonderful. 

Please visit our website at http://www.gsror.com/adoptionapp/ to complete an online application.

If this will be your first GSD then please go to http://www.gsror.com/gsd-rightu/ before filling out an application.

name: Woodie
description: 0819404 -Introducing, Woodie! We're not sure of his mix, but he appears to have some chihuahua and jack russel in him, and he's approx 3yrs old. He came to us from a shelter in Roswell, NM. Woodie'sready to find his forever home! He gets along great with kids and dogs, and really likes guys. He immediately took to my 19yr old son and his friend who lives with us. He also get's along great with the 3 dogs in his foster home! He's quiet and and loves to cuddle. This little dude is gonna be a great family dog!

name: Mocha
description:
Meet Mocha, we saved Mocha from the shelter in Aztec, NM. She is approximately 2 years old and loves people and children.

 Mocha needs to be in a home with at least no other female dogs and with males that would be submissive. It would truly be best for her to be the only dog in the home. 

 Mocha is very curious of cats but she hasn't been taken off leash around them yet so not certain quiet yet if she will be good with cats or not.

 She loves attention though and always wants to be around people.

 Mocha is crate trained and knows basic commands, She is fully potty trained and knows how to use a dog door.

 From what little time we have had her it is clear her past humans weren't the best to her but that does not keep her from being a very sweet and she will be an awesome companion for someone who is ready to love her!

All animals adopted from us are fully vetted including spay/neuter, vaccines, microchip, heartworm test and deworming. Please email us at HookedOnDobies@gmail.com, visit our Facebook page www.facebook.com/savingdobermankind or webpage https://www.savingdobermankind.org to request an application, inquire about an adoption fee, or to learn more! 

We do require a completed adoption application to be submitted before discussing details of a specific Doberman. 

We DO NOT have a central location, out foster homes are located throughout our geographic region including CO, WY, NM and TX.

We strive to PROTECT the privacy of out fosters. ALL Doberman meet and greets are conducted in a neutral meeting location made by appointment only.

name: Star
description:
Star
Female
Italian Greyhound / Terrier mix
Born 10/2014

Contact Kate at kmolsbe@gmail.com for more information about Star.

Starlight...Starbright - here is beautiful Star!!  Born approx. October 2014 and weighing 25 pounds, Star was recently returned to NMAF after 2.5 years when her family moved to Wisconsin and Star could not adapt to the change.  Rather than have her rehomed so far away, she flew back to ABQ and is safely back in foster care and doing well.  She has changed very little in her time gone from NM and is still the same sleek size and weight she was 2.5 years ago (wouldn't we all like that!!).  We think she is an Italian Greyhound mix because of her long legs and slender, graceful body, and she still loves to do her \"Ballerina Twirl\" at feeding time (see her video).  She has a shiny black coat that sheds very little, pretty white socks and a star shaped mark on her neck.  She loves soft touches under her chin, gives LOTS of kisses, and special stuffed toys - especially the stuffing!  Unfortunately, she doesn't like kitties but enjoys the company of other friendly dogs, though is not much of a \"player\" and could easily be happy as an only dog - preferably with someone that is retired or works from home.

Star came back to NMAF with some anxiety and reactivity issues which, with calming medication and retraining that includes impulse control with our trainer, Natalie Cabral, she has turned a corner and is ready for a new life!  NMAF will train her adopter with the skills required to work with her and keep her well balanced and happy.  She should not live with children as they bring on anxiety - this may be due to too much rough handling in her previous family where their were very small children present.  She would be a great dog for a single female or male in a quiet environment or a retired couple.  She is spayed, up-to-date on all shots, heartworm tested & on preventative, and microchipped.  She also uses a doggie door and is house-trained.  She does not attend our Adoption Clinic at PetSmart but can be met at her foster home most evenings.  This little girl is really special, sweet, and loving once she trusts you, and can be a wonderful companion for the right owner.

Because home visits are required, NMAF dogs cannot be adopted out of the greater Albuquerque / Santa Fe area.

Star does not attend our Adoption Clinic at PetSmart but can be met at her foster home most evenings.  Please contact the person listed above to meet Star.

Please visit our website at www.nmaf.org for more information.

My foster Mother and host, Mare herself, states that I would easily make an exceptional town house (or condo) companion because I am so very relaxed indoors! name: Yahtzee
description: Yahtzee is a 10 year 29 pound beautiful fawn color Cocker Spaniel. CAWS pulled Yahtzee from a Valencia, NM shelter where he was found as a stray, and hitched a ride on a transport back to Utah. He arrived very sick and lethargic. Took him to the vet within a couple days and learned he had pneumonia and bad ear infections. He was placed in isolation for a few weeks to get over his illness and regain his strength. Once he was able to get out and be a part of the family pack, hes been thriving ever since. Our little man was a fighter who wanted to live and now be part of the good life! Yahtzee has had a dental with 12 extractions. He has arthritis in his back legs and hips so will be on pain medications for the rest of his life. Due to this arthritis he should be in a home with very minimal steps or none at all. Yahtzee can totally be trusted in the home when his 2 legged people arent home. He is dog door trained. He loves his 4 legged siblings, male and female, small and large. He doesnt sleep on the couch or bed, he prefers a bed on the floor. His sight isnt 100% but he sees enough to get around. His hearing might be a little less than stellar as well. He is a very nervous little man, he will pace at times and his legs shake with nervousness. Yahtzee will play with chew toys on the floor every once in a while and he loves to tear up empty paper towel and toilet paper rolls. With his big floppy ears he comes to share after hes had a drink by dragging his ears across you, so cute, well okay, really kind of not that cute, but it goes with the territory. He will need regular grooming. This precious and sweet little man is pure as they come. Now its his time to find his forever family that will show him the unconditional love he deserves! He will surely melt your heart. Due to Yahtzees nervousness he needs to go to a home with no children, or at least older. He also needs a home with a fenced yard and no stairs, or very minimal steps due to his arthritis in his back legs and hips. Yahtzee is not a barker, very occasional yap. If you are interested in adopting a CAWS pet, please fill out an online application at http://caws.org/adoption-application

name: Chicago
description:
Namesakes that stretch across the country! From sea to shining sea, from mountain ranges, from South to North....travel the City litter! Houston, Chicago, Raleigh, Seattle, Milwaukee, Boston, and Detroit have their bags packed and are ready to lay roots in their forever homes! They were all rescued from Loris, South Carolina. This busy litter of 5-month-old labrador collie mixes are comfortable in their crates, working on pottying training and are social, happy little travelers ready for their last adventure...into the perfect family!

This litter is spayed/neutered, up-to-date on vaccinations, and microchipped.

Home for Good Dog Rescue (HFGDR) is a 100 percent foster-based rescue located in Summit with offices in Berkeley Heights, NJ. All of our dogs live in loving local foster homes until they find forever families of their own. Our fosters begin basic training, housebreaking, and leash walking skills to help pair you with the perfect pup for life! 

We update Petfinder and our website multiple times daily, so if a dog is available on Petfinder and our website they are still available for adoption. We process all our applications in the order we receive them, and for that reason sometimes the dog or dogs in whom you are interested in may be adopted before your own processing concludes. 

In order to apply for adoption and set up an individual meet and greet with one of our dogs, please visit us at www.HomeforGoodDogs.org. 

Find us on Facebook at www.facebook.com/HomeForGoodDogRescue.

name: Dia

She will not allow other dogs near her puppies, but enjoys the company of her canine foster sister on walks. Her quiet demeanor may be explained in part by her heartworm positive status. This will be treated prior to her adoption being finalized. Come meet Dia and her beautiful family at their public debut at Camp Canine in Bristol on Sunday September 22nd from 11-2

name: Cassi
description: Amazing! Cassi and her sole surviving puppy were saved from a high kill shelter in North Carolina. She is indeed amazing in so many ways. As a lab/boxer mix she has a wonderful personality. She is good in any situation be it with other dogs, kids, walks, or rides in the car. (Okay, she does get nervous at the vet and doesnt like to have her nails clipped, but those are her only flaws).Cassi is only about a year old and displays a maturity you might not expect. She weighs around 57 pounds. She has a short coat that is a mix of brown and white. Lots of white on all four paws, a beautiful white chest, and a perfectly symmetrical face. She has those warm friendly brown eyes that let you know that she likes to be with people.She has been living in her southern foster home with three dogs and two kids. She gets along fine with her canine friends and LOVES the kids. Boxers are known for their legendary patience and gentleness with kids. Labs are known for their easy going friendliness, sweet-naturedness, and a desire to please. Cassi has inherited these wonderful traits making her a very desirable companion.Another plus is that Cassi is house, crate, and leash trained. (Of course, you know that even trained dogs may have an occasional accident as they adjust to the new family and routine). Cassi needs plenty of exercise as she is just beginning her teen years. A few walks a day, or play time with other dogs at a dog park, and free time in the back yard all will help burn off her energy. It is not to imply that she is high energy, shes not. Even when left alone at home, she has been good, but then again Cassi is one special pup. So, is Cassi the pup for you? If yes, head over to our Adoption Application and submit your application today. Her fee for adoption is $450. That includes the cost of spaying, up to date vaccinations, transport and rescue fees. A Dog Star representative will contact you within 24 hours of receiving the application. To help speed up the process, please call your vet and give them permission to speak with us. If you do not get a response within 24 hours of submitting your application, please check your spam folder.

description:

Meet Kiwi! I swear he has one of the cutest little faces and always looks like he is smiling! Saved from a kill shelter in North Carolina, Kiwi and his littermates traveled up to Connecticut to find their perfect homes. Currently Kiwi is 9-10 weeks old and 11lbs! We are guessing this group are labrador and collie mixes, based on colors and temperament, but likely a few other things thrown in too. He will make a wonderful addition to any family looking to welcome a puppy. Please apply today! 


All of our puppies are crate trained and learning basic puppy manners!
  
When he is available he will be 9-10 weeks old, up to date on vaccines, microchipped, dewormed, flea treated, examined and give a health certificate before traveling and then examined again by our CT veterinarian to ensure his health.  

Adoption fee is $400.00  which includes all of the above, his transport, and a puppy pack including his medical records, copy of the adoption contract (which we would need you to sign for our records, as well) and a digital emailed copy of various puppy information (housetraining tips, vaccine information, socialization tips, pet insurance etc). We will have information on the food that he has been eating and that we highly recommend. The supportive store where we hold our meetings carries the food so you can purchase a bag if you wish! Since he is not neutered yet, this is the new owner's responsibility once he reaches 6 to 9 months of age. 

The benefit of our organization is that you get to meet the puppy before you commit to adopting! We want perfect matches and happy families!

description:
Panda came to our foundation with several other Aussie mix dogs from North Carolina.  She was quiet but friendly and very loving.  We soon discovered that this young girl was expecting puppies.  A litter of pups were born on 5/10/19.  They were every color imaginable.  Some had short coats and a few had fluffy coats.  They are all now ready for adoption.  They have their Mom's wonderful temperament.  They are curious and active, sweet and friendly.

If you can make a lifetime commitment to a puppy, please submit an application to adopt on our website:  thesimonfoundation.org

name: Amour
description: Amour came to us from North Carolina just one day after giving birth to her five beautiful puppies. She has been a fantastic mom. Her puppies have gone to their foreverhomes so Amour is looking for family of her own. Amour is housebroken.. She is a little too interested in the ferrets in her foster home and loves to chase squirrels in the yard. She will walk for miles but does need a little work on her leash manners. She forgets there is a human attached when she sees a squirrel. Otherwise she is a perfect companion, up for run in the yard or a cuddle on the couch. Amour gets along with some other dogs with a proper introduction but is looking to be an only dog. She wants to be queen of her castle.

name: Zara
description:
Meet Zara!

Is there anything better in this world than a black pibble??!! I honestly don't think so! Maybe a black pibble who loves lounging?! 

Meet Zara! This adorable girl was saved from a high-kill shelter in North Carolina. She has since been fully vetted and is living with her foster family where she is learning all the ropes (clearly!). Zara is between 1-2 years old and a perfect 30 pounds!! She is also fully vetted and dog approved! 

If you would like to meet/adopt Zara, please complete an application on our website: 

www.NewEnglandHumaneSociety.com    Adoption Fee$ 500.00

name: Bobby
description:
Bobby's mom has cancer and can no longer take care of him.  It's heartbreaking that at eight years old he now is finding himself homeless and looking for someone that can open their hearts to give him a home and love.

He has not been used to children so we are thinking a home that is with someone older and more quiet.  He's a little fellow and doesn't ask for much.  He's be rather independent allowing himself in and out through a doggie door.  He likes to be pet, but does not like to be picked up.  Bobby is not a happy dog.....he's very chill and has settled in to his temporary quarters very well.

This is a courtesy post for his good Samaritan who is caring for him in NC at this time.  We will accept applications through our rescue and process for his adoption.  Please note our adoption process is as follows:

Our online application is available under the link :  http://www.diamonddogsrescueinc.com/online-adoption-application.html

Please do not fill out on a mobile application as it does not allow form to be submitted.  It should be filled out and submitted on a computer.
 
When your application is received we process by reviewing all references and then setting up your conference or meeting with the foster family after those references have been checked.    Because our foster families volunteer to open their hearts and homes to our rescues, we try to lessen the amount of interference with their lives by only allowing pre-approved adopters to meet the dog and/or call the foster family to ask questions about the dog.   The pre-approval process does not obligate you and would NOT require a home visit until you have spoken with or met with the foster family to be sure the dog is right for you.   Once that occurs and you are committed to adopting our rescue, then we will schedule your home visit.  

PLEASE NOTE:  SOME DOGS MAY NOT BE AVAILABLE FOR A MEET AND GREET.  Because we are a foster based rescue, our rescues are transported to our foster families AFTER they have been vetted and are cleared for transport medically.  Although our company has headquarters in New Jersey and our second location in Mass, where they end up being fostered depends on which foster is available at that time (our pet finder site only allows us to post in New Jersey or Mass, not where dogs are fostered).   Our foster team members are located from North Carolina all the way to Southern Maine.  IF THEY ARE BEING FOSTERED OUTSIDE OF THE AREA THAT YOU COULD EASILY TRAVEL TO, we arrange for you to speak with the foster to determine if the dog is what you are expecting.  So, if the dogs are not being fostered close enough to visit prior to adoption and this is not acceptable to you, please do not fill out an application. 

In many cases our rescues are adopted directly from their vetting and quarantine and do not even get to foster.  Many families are comfortable for a direct adoption, especially with puppies or with the evaluation provided by our references and our rescue trainer.   In this case they are transported to the adopter and our adoption contract provides for a thirty day refund of your adoption fee for any reason.   The dog is returned to us if they are not working and it cannot be resolved to yours and to our satisfaction. 

From this point, with all information on the application being acceptable and the home visit satisfactory,  the applicant is approved and the adoption takes place.  Your contracts are emailed and your adoption fee will be $350 (that includes all medical and transport fees).   Once contracts are signed and your adoption fee paid,  arrangements are made to transport the dog to his/her home, whether it be from a foster or from our vet clinic.  

Beyond the thirty refund policy in our adoption contract, Diamond Dogs Rescue, Inc. offers a lifetime guarantee on all of its animals.  If for any reason an owner needs to return the adopted dog, Diamond Dogs Rescue, Inc. always welcomes the pooch's return and your contract will provide for this.

name: Holland
description:
Described by the shelter as a gentle, dog and cat friendly two year old hound....and his time was up!  Sadly hound dogs in the south are plentiful and finding them as intentional strays even more plentiful.   But because of our experience with this wonderful breed of dog we were happy to be part of his rescue!

True to his breed, Holland has a wonderful Temperament: Easygoing, Even Tempered, Adaptable, Trusting, Gentle, Lovable.  He's thought to be an English Coonhound so will be on the smaller side weighing in at 55lbs.  An active household will do. best for his age and energy level.

Fully vetted, neutered, microchipped and ready to head home, Holland is only a transport away from his forever family.

name: Mister B
description:
3 yr old Collie Blend
Neutered
UTD on Vaccines
House trained
Crate trained (he sleeps with door open) 
Can have free reign of house and doesnât chew or mess
Great with other dogs (proper intros of course)
No cats
Older respectful kid friendly
Loves to go for rides
Walks good on a leash
Knows sit/come
Very loyal dog

There was once someone who loved him.......
But now he's gone. You see, Mister B was found in his home with his deceased owner.

With no one to care, no one to step up for him....he found himself in Rockingham Shelter. Mister stayed 1 month in the shelter and he was so scared and didnât understand what was going on. After a month, with NO ONE interested in saving his life, Mister found himself on the list to be euthanized in the morning. It seemed hopeless, until Diamond Dogs Rescue saw him and learned he was left alone in this world separated from his owner by death.

When we saw the beaded collar that was lovingly hand made, still on him in the shelter it broke our hearts to think his short life would end alone in a shelter, with no one to care if he lived or died. Diamond Dogs Rescue saw the emptiness in his eyes and just HAD TO SAVE HIM!

His foster mom can tell he was close to his owner. \"If I get to far away from him he just barks and cries. This breaks my heart. Heâs only 3 yrs old but he is also heart worm positive\". So, right now he's being treated for his heart worm and will then be available to a good home. That should be around the end of September.  Help share Mister's story so we can find his family and help his broken heart heal.  You can see photos and day to day information on him on his very own Facebook page at:
https://www.facebook.com/A-Rescues-journey-Meet-Mister-B-110504020293418/?modal=admin_todo_tour

name: JEWEL
description: Meet Jewel! This beautiful pup had a rough start to life. We brought her to SASF from a high-kill shelter in North Carolina. She had been found extremely neglected and malnourished. She is now gaining weight and ready to start the next chapter of life. Shortly after Jewel arrived at SASF, we realized that she is deaf, but that doesn't stop her from being friendly and energetic. This pretty pup loves to run around and would love to live in an active household. She would love a fenced in yard or a promise of many adventurous walks and hikes. Jewel would do best with kids 12, but would prefer to be the only dog in the home. She needs a family who is committed to teaching her basic obedience and showing her wat a loving forever family looks like. If you're looking for an adorable, energetic pup, stop by to meet Jewel today!

name: Charlie
description:
Charlie was with 3 other siblings when they were pulled from a shelter in North Carolina.  Charlie was a bit shy at first but he is gaining confidence and has a wonderful temperament.  He is eager to learn and please.  He is dog selective and afraid of cats.  Older children that have been around dogs will be okay.  Charlie will need basic obedience training and plenty of daily exercise. 

If you are interested in adopting a dog, please submit an application on our website:  thesimonfoundation.org

name: Ceylon
description: Black lab mix from North Carolina who came to us with 5 adorable puppies. Ceylon loves people and can't get enough belly rubs. She is doing great with her leash training. She is completely house trained and stays in her crate nicely if needed. She is not a chewer and loves loves loves her toys. Her perfect day is a nice walk then cuddling on the couch or in bed. She is amazing with children, she is gentle and loving withthem. Her one goal in life is to be with her humans. Her pups have all founds their homes and now it is her turn. She will have to be the only pet in the home, we don't know her story but she does not trust other dogs. For more information or to meet this sweet girl please contact us.

name: Oden
description:
He doesn't understand why his feet are hurting.  He only knows he's in pain.   He scared and doesn't know why he's here.  He only knows the other crying and barking dogs must know something more than he does.
And, his time is up!

But there's a group of people networking for him.  Sending his video around, asking for help.   And we saw it just in time!

Oden was saved 24 hours before there was no longer a choice.  He was taken to our vets office where he was treated for. his infected paws brought current on all vaccines, neutered, microchipped and given a wellness checkover.  Now he's at our trainers in Wilmington area of NC learning some basic training and doing very well.  

Thought to be around 3-4 years old, Oden is around 54lbs.  He loves outdoors and was sad to be kenneled while being cared for medically.   He will be so glad when his \"new beginning\" starts and he can leave the pain and his old life behind.

Our trainer is JeffColtenback.com who will work with you to learn all about Oden and help you welcome him into your home.   A Facebook page has been set up to view his progress and story.  A rescue's journey- Meet Oden.

name: Bailey
description:
An all around good dog.....just another victim of irresponsible owners!  Bailey is heart worm positive and his time was up without anyone stepping up to consider his rescue.  But the shelter volunteers loved this dog enough to reach out with a special plea and we listened.

Bailey is a handsome guy who is around two years old.  He's super friendly and weighs around 50lbs....just the right size.  You really are going to LOVE this dog.  He's been a bit shy during his heart worm treatment but so accommodating and gentle.  Bailey is on the slim side with a beautiful Blue/Silver coat.

Still a little unsure of people he doesnât know but warms up quickly with love and attention. Very alert. Will need to run and be exercised. Not sure he is a candidate for an apartment.

Heart worm treatment has been completed and he's ready for a family to love.... he's been neutered, brought current on all vaccines, microchipped and de-wormed.

name: Teddy
description:
Teddy is a 6 year old retriever mix who's around 69lbs.  When we were asked to give him a second chance in his life we knew this handsome boy was in line next to be euthanized.  Just in time......he's now been given that chance!

Teddy is being treated for heart worm and during this time he's being fostered.  The foster family has said he's a gentle big boy who's good with other dogs and is doing well.  He's the funniest dog and we just adore him.  He's laid back, loving and will make anyone a great family pet addition.

Teddy was published...

Within in the next month, Teddy will be ready for a home, having been heart worm treated, neutered, fully vaccinated and microchipped.  

Looking for that big boy who ready for his new life?  Check him out! YOU ARE GONNA LOVE LOVE LOVE HIM!

name: Sammy
description:
The shelter volunteer wrote, \"I'm watching Sammy as he's playing outside and for this moment he's just a dog playing with his ball.  He doesn't know he is on todays kill list!\"  His time was up and to a large dog already around two years old who is heart worm positive that's like a death sentence down south!  The cost to treat for rescues typically has them shying away from the added expense to an already busting budget.   BUT....because someone LOVED this dog very much and took the time to message us for his life Sammy was saved!

Sammy not only had heart worm, but a couple other issues that were treated by our vet.  He's been neutered and brought current on all vaccines.  He's a big boy weighing in at around 68lbs and is a beautiful mix breed with the most expressive eyes!  Now he's completed all treatment and is ready for a home.

Play and quite a meatball without being over the top, Sammy is like a little kid on the playground.  He loves running and playing and chasing a ball.  He likes to lay on the ground and savor a belly rub and he give the best kisses of gratitude.  Sammy is good with other dogs...actually doing the belly crawl.  Because he looks like he's a dog that could hold his own, we never thought he'd be the less dominant dog.  He's sweet and easy going and enjoys being outdoors with his human.  This dog reminds us of the way life was meant to be....living every moment carefree!

name: Romeo
description:
Named by the \"village\" that helped to save him our Romeo was a total mess.  The people of the community watched him day in and day out scavenging for food, but staying distant.  He had an embedded collar and it was badly infected.  Our vet said this was one of the worst embedded collars they had seen.  This poor dog was so sick from infection that finally capturing him was a matter of him no longer having the strength to run.  But, once captured, it was as if he was thankful they had him!

Romeo has been treated and is nicely mended.  He's learning how much love and attention humans can give and he's responding in thankful kindness.  He's been fully brought Current on vaccines, neutered, microchipped and treated in preparing for a home.  Still with our vet in North Carolina he's being posted so that we can find his family and have him sent home.

Romeo is a beautiful, loving, sweet and still a bit shy....but warms up quickly to love and patience.  This is a dog that was likely in a home before being left on his own.   He's still young, maybe between 1-2 years old and so handsome.  Once his beautiful coat comes back in fully and he puts on some weight, he will be even more good looking!

Because Romeo was a stray and spent a good amount of time on his own, avoiding being captured, it is likely he will need longer than the normal dog to adjust and feel comfortable with his new home and knowing happiness.  Dogs like this learn quickly, but patience will be what's needed.  You will be rewarded three fold for time invested in this handsome boy!

Our online application is available under the link located below:
Please do not fill out on a mobile application as it does not allow form to be submitted. It should be filled out and submitted on a computer. 
http://www.diamonddogsrescueinc.com/online-adoption-application.html

When your application is received we process by reviewing all references and then setting up your conference or meeting with the foster family after those references have been checked. Because our foster families volunteer to open their hearts and homes to our rescues, we try to lessen the amount of interference with their lives by only allowing pre-approved adopters to meet the dog and/or call the foster family to ask questions about the dog. The pre-approval process does not obligate you and would NOT require a home visit until you have spoken with or met with the foster family to be sure the dog is right for you. Once that occurs and you are committed to adopting our rescue, then we will schedule your home visit. 

PLEASE NOTE: SOME DOGS MAY NOT BE AVAILABLE FOR A MEET AND GREET. Because we are a foster based rescue, our rescues are transported to our foster families AFTER they have been vetted and are cleared for transport medically. Although our company has headquarters in New Jersey and our second location in Mass, where they end up being fostered depends on which foster is available at that time (our pet finder site only allows us to post in New Jersey or Mass, not where dogs are fostered). Our foster team members are located from North Carolina all the way to Southern Maine. IF THEY ARE BEING FOSTERED OUTSIDE OF THE AREA THAT YOU COULD EASILY TRAVEL TO, we arrange for you to speak with the foster to determine if the dog is what you are expecting. So, if the dogs are not being fostered close enough to visit prior to adoption and this is not acceptable to you, please do not fill out an application.

In many cases our rescues are adopted directly from their vetting and quarantine and do not even get to foster. Many families are comfortable for a direct adoption, especially with puppies or with the evaluation provided by our references and our rescue trainer. In this case they are transported to the adopter and our adoption contract provides for a thirty day refund of your adoption fee for any reason. The dog is returned to us if they are not working and it cannot be resolved to yours and to our satisfaction. 

From this point, with all information on the application being acceptable and the home visit satisfactory, the applicant is approved and the adoption takes place. Your contracts are emailed and your adoption fee will be $350 (that includes all medical and transport fees). Once contracts are signed and your adoption fee paid, arrangements are made to transport the dog to his/her home, whether it be from a foster or from our vet clinic. 

Beyond the thirty refund policy in our adoption contract, Diamond Dogs Rescue, Inc. offers a lifetime guarantee on all of its animals. If for any reason an owner needs to return the adopted dog, Diamond Dogs Rescue, Inc. always welcomes the pooch's return and your contract will provide for this.

name: Parker
description:
Meet Parker!

Parker came to us from North Carolina during the summer and we were so excited to find this awesome dog a his forever home. We quickly noticed how much fun he was and loved getting him together with a few other dogs and watch Parker run circles around them. He loves to play fetch and like a true cattle dog can easily keep up on a really nice hike or run!

We quickly adopted him out to a fantastic family that opened up their home and hearts to this beautiful boy. Once he was settled in they noticed some behaviors they needed help with so we quickly stepped in to help train Parker. After a few months of training we had to come to the tough decision that Parker was just not the right fit for this great family. While he was great with them for most of their time together, Parker is socially dominant. We believe he would be a great dog for a family without young children and who are open to learning the training we offer to make sure Parker can live the happiest life possible.

Parker is house broken, crate trained, and very dog friendly. We have prepared Parker with the training needed and now we are looking for a family to take the tools we offer to continue his journey into becoming a great doggie citizen!

For more information visit our website at adoptadog.org or to submit an application please visit: goo.gl/VEjhLX

Iâm from North Carolina where I lived in a shelter for the past few months until I made my journey to LaMancha. I am an awesome, gentle and pleasant girl who always wears a smile on my face. My positive energy is contagious--I spread good vibes. My shimmering, elegant black coat is gorgeous, but look deep into my warm brown eyes and stare at my beautiful big smile.  Can you feel my warm, friendly presence?  I have lots of fans. Shelby came to us from North Carolina. She is about 47 pounds and is guessed to be a beagle/harrier hound mix. Shelby loves to play with the other dogs in the rescue. She is working on her house training and is well on her way, so far she has not gone in her crate, but needs to learn how to tell her humans when she needs to go out.   Shelby loves hanging out in the house and is pretty much a couch potato. Shelby is guessed to be around 4 years of age. She is a sweet hound that loves the attention of people.

Sissy came to us from North Carolina. She is about 35 pounds and is guessed to be a hound mix. Sissy loves to play with the other dogs in the rescue. She does ok on a leash and is crate trained. Not sure if she is totally house trained, but she is well on her way, so far she has not gone in her crate nor in the house.  She will need a fenced in yard.  Sissy is guessed to be around 4 years of age. She is a sweet little hound that loves the attention of people. She also loves to hang out in the kiddy pool when it is hot outside.
Sissy is up to date on her vaccines and is micro chipped. She will be spayed before adoption. If you are interested in Sissy please fill out an application at www.itavar.com

name: Rufus
description:
Rufus came to our rescue from a kill shelter in North Carolina with heartworms. We put him through heartworm treatment and now he is done his treatment and feeling like a healthy happy 2 year old.  Rufus had not been taught anything before we rescued him and he is work in progress and learning quickly. Rufus is being fostered in a home with dogs, cats and lots of children and a few adults. He is a happy go lucky dog that is now finally learning some structure. Rufus loves people and just wants attention. He has a lot of energy, as a 2 year old should and would love an active family. He has been known to get in the water with some coaxing. Rufus is working on his crate training (it is getting him in the crate, once in, he is fine) and he is working on his leash walking, he does like to pull, but the foster started using an easy walk on him and it has helped a lot.  He is house trained. 
Rufus is micro chipped, up to date on all of his vaccines and neutered. If you are interested in adopting Rufus please fill out an application at www.itavar.com

name: Tapestry
description:
Tapestry, aka Tappie, is a beautiful Brindle that came to us from a shelter in North Carolina. We believe she is a Mountain Cur/Catahoula/Terrier mix. She weighs about 45 pounds and is believed to be about 3 years old. Tappie went to Ventosa Kennels in North Carolina to get some training and has earned her certificate. She is looking for a home with people that have energy like she does. She would make a great jogging or running partner. Tappie is crate trained, house trained and has learned âsitâ and âdownâ.  She does well on a leash, though daily practice is a must.  Tappie loves her humans, big or small, though she is extremely picky on her dog playmates, this is why she would do best being the only dog in the house. Tapestry must have a fenced in yard because of all of her energy, so she needs a place to run to get out all of her energy.
Tapestry is spayed, micro chipped and up to date on all of her vaccines.
If you are interested in Tapestry please fill out our application which can be found on our web site www.itavar.com

name: Tim

Dont let his big face or tough exterior run you away. he is very lovable and enjoys human company. Tim is from a rescue out of North Carolina, along with a few others he was fleeing the hurricane and floods. Tim made it all the way to our facility to find his new home. if you are interested in meeting Tim ask a kennel tech to set up a meet and greet.

name: Apollo Hound
description:
Handsome 'people' boyHello! My name is Apollo Hound aka Apollo, and I am a 2 year old, 55 lb foxhound mix. I am a loving and loyal dog, but I need to let you know that I am insecure. I have gained confidence with a consistent routine, and with patience and reassurance from my past foster and the awesome human heroes that have saved me and are currently looking out for me. I came from North Carolina where I was wandering the streets, and the human that saved me did not know much about my past. However, a few things about me have been figured out: I want to please and I will work hard to understand my new home and surroundings. I love to be loved and give love right back. I am insecure, but willing and wanting to trust. I learn quickly, such as sit, down, stay/wait and I am ready to learn more. New people worry me so do new buildings. I do not like going into buildings/homes I'm not familiar with. I will follow when I trust, and especially if I have a dog buddy. I tend to trust a woman more than a man. Men wearing hats scare me, but I will warm up to a man over time, especially if one of my dog buddies trusts him. I realize I keep mentioning dog buddies. I love dogs. Dogs are my buddies!! They make me feel safe and I love to play with them. I am still learning that humans know how to play - that sometimes is so weird to me! I SHOULD NEVER BE TRUSTED WITH CATS. I like walks and am learning how to play fetch. I am mostly housebroken, but I am still learning. I need a consistent routine. I do OK in crates, but I don't like crates and storms. I have been known to escape them. There is so much that I have to offer to your home and I can't wait to be a part of your family.Apollo Hound should go into an adult only home.
Apollo's adoption donation fee is $280, which includes spay/neuter, routine vetting and a microchip. You can apply for Apollo by filling out our online application, which is found on our website www.tarashouse.net or www.tarashouse.org. Please email us at info@tarashouse.net with any questions.

name: Skinner
description:
Hi everyone, my name is Skinner! I am 10 years old and I may look huge but I'm a compact 50 pounds of love! I came to the sanctuary all the way from North Carolina when a nice pilot flew me here to find a better life. I wasn't treated very well before so I'm enjoying taking my time getting to know people and being treated the way I deserve. Despite my past I am a very sweet boy who loves to go for walks and snuggle once I get to know you! I came to the sanctuary Heartworm positive but after treatment I am all clear and doing very well! 
I love to run around outside so a home with a yard is a must for me; I am truly happiest when I am outside.
Come to the sanctuary to meet me!

name: Rj
description: RJ is a sweet guy. He is 4 years old and enjoys the company of others, RJ should definitely go to a home where there are NO OTHER DOGS AT ALL. Rj came to us from a rescue out of North Carolina and is currently looking for his forever home. He loves to run and play, so he would be a perfect dog to be active with! RJ is fully vaccinated, microchipped and neutered. if he is the perfect fir for you come on in and meet with him!

name: Jake N
description: Jake is a big hound who was rescued from North Carolina last year. He had been neglected and was gravely ill, but volunteers at HART nursed him back to health. He is very loving and has such a sweet soul. He gets along well with the other dogs in his foster home and is even fine with the cats. Jake has wonderful manners: completely housebroken, walks well on a leash, doesn't beg or jump, likes to sleep in, and keeps off the furniture. He is pretty calm and quiet and doesn't even bark at the neighbor's dogs! Jake doesn't ask for much - just someone who will give him plenty of love but also set firm boundaries for him in order to set him up for success. Give this poor hound, who has suffered so much, a chance at happiness! Thank you for your interest in this HART pet! Please visit www.hart90.org/petdetail.aspx?ID=11643 to email the contact person listed for more information and how to meet Jake N, or to submit an online application. HART adopts to the local DC/VA/MD metro area only. Visit our website for more information about our adoption process.

name: Farrah
description: Farrah is a sweet girl with plenty of tail wags for everyone. She came to HART from North Carolina where she was surrendered by her owner, along with her puppies Alan and Walter, who have since been adopted. When she first arrived in the NC shelter, she was very confused by her new surroundings, but once she adjusted, she was all tail wags and wiggles! Farrah loves people and other dogs. She can come on a bit strong because she is so happy to make new friends, but she settles well. Thank you for your interest in this HART pet! Please visit www.hart90.org/petdetail.aspx?ID=12245 to email the contact person listed for more information and how to meet Farrah, or to submit an online application. name: Simba
description: Meet Simba, named after the character in the Disney movie The Lion King.  Simba means powerful warrior, and his name certainly suits him.  Simba was pulled from a high kill shelter in North Carolina on his very last day.  Simba came to us emaciated and covered with horrible scars and bite wounds.  Everywhere on his poor, frail body had either scabs, open wounds or scars.  We estimate Simba to be around two years old and is a bully breed mix.  He is a big eater, but does not show any food aggression or guarding at all, which is amazing considering he was nearly starved to death.  Simba would benefit from some training, as he was never taught leash manners.  He has not shown any aggression toward other dogs or cats, although he will sometimes growl if he feels threatened by another dog so a very careful and proper introduction to any other dogs will be necessary.  Considering everything he has been through, we do not blame Simba one bit for his concerns.  Simba has a wonderful personality - he is very energetic and LOVES toys.  He loves to carry his blanket around and play with it.  He will play with basically anything he can find.  Simba loves people and will sit still and soak up all the love and attention you are willing to give him.  Simba is house and crate-trained, up to date on all shots, heartworm negative and on heartworm, flea and tick prevention.  Simba clearly had a really rough past and although his body will always likely bear the scars, he did not let his past form his personality.  \"Scars remind us of where we have been, but they do not have to dictate where we are going.â  And this is certainly true for Simba.  Please consider opening your heart and home to this sweet boy and finding out for yourself what an amazing boy he is â you wonât regret it!

name: Karma
description: Karma was saved from North Carolina where she spent her life chained to a tree.  . She is a sweet girl that LOVES to play and be near you. description:

up-to-date on vaccines
neutered
microchipped

name: Lilly (PA)
description:
Hi, my name is Lil, or as my foster parents call me Lilly Lou. I grew up living in a home in North Carolina but after one of my people passed away the other got really sick and could no longer care for me. I was dropped off at a crowded shelter in the mountains of North Carolina. I wasnât really a big fan of being in the shelter and that is when Pointer Rescue Org showed up and I left with my foster parents. I had a long road trip from North Carolina to Harrisburg, Pennsylvania where Iâm now learning about lots of new things and am excited to find my new forever home. I am a very happy girl that LOVES to be around people and snuggle them on the couch. Every person I have seen I have wanted to meet. The same goes for dogs of all sizes. I enjoy soft, comfortable dog beds where I can get some sun but donât really like laying outside in the hot sun. Iâm not too sure about a lot of dog toys but I really like the soft, fuzzy ones that I can chew on. I get along with the other dog in the house but Iâm not a big fan of playing rough. Just laying around and being close to each other is ok with me. My foster parents tell me I walk well on a leash and donât pull and if I do I know to slow down to let them catch up. I know how to sit, especially if you have some yummy treats for me and will come when called. I LOVE Food and Treats and love to be in the kitchen anytime there is food being cooked. I was told Iâm not the best sous chef but Iâm probably the cutest one. I do like to check out whatâs on the kitchen counter but if you tell me Off I will sadly get off the counter. I enjoy going for walks and hiking but so far I donât like going into any water but I do enjoy a good mud bath. In my dream home I would be the only dog or have a brother or sister that is just as relaxed as me. Iâm a good sleeper and will gladly sleep all night in my kennel unless there is a thunder storm. Iâm not sure about those and if we have one I like to be under the covers in bed with my foster family. If you are looking for a relaxed, sweet southern girl, look no further!

Lil is a white English Pointer with some tan spots. She is around 6-7 years old, up to date on all of her shots (none due until July of 2020), spayed, microchipped, and tested negative for heartworms. She is on monthly flea/tick and heartworm preventative and has been strategically dewormed. She does well with ear cleanings and brushing but needs some coaxing to get a bath and would do best with a groomer or vet trimming her nails.
Interested in fostering? Fill out our volunteer application here: http:// www.pointerrescue.org/ helpus.html
TRANSPORT AVAILABLE TO APPROVED HOMES! (Generally, within 1500 miles)
Can't foster right now, but want to help?
Consider sponsoring a dog by making a donation to help with vetting costs. PRO is 501c3 non-profit and is fully funded by donations, your tax-deductible gift would be greatly appreciated! 
http:// www.pointerrescue.org/ donation.html

name: Timber
description:
Timber is incredibly handsome, smart and gentle.  The shelter networked long and hard to save him because he was such a great dog.   The video on his page was the video sent with a plea to please rescue as his time was up and NO ONE stepped up. How could you not take this dog?  Not only was he sweet and gentle but he was this way with a horrible infection that had been caused by being neutered....and he was still willing to sit/lay even through the pain.

We're not so sure of this handsome boys breed....all guesses. But we are sure of his good nature.  He's fully vetted, neutered, microchipped and ready to find a family that won't abandon him again!  We have a full trainer evaluation available to be emailed to you -just ask.   Our trainer's comments were \"I LOVE THIS DOG\" and we do to!  

We also have a great program available for foster to adopt when approved.  Check out the information at:
https://www.facebook.com/notes/toni-diamond/have-you-wanted-to-adopt-but-felt-concerned-that-it-might-be-a-dog-that-didnt-fi/10157161089056634/

OUR ADOPTION PROCESS:
Our online application is available under the link located at: 
https://www.facebook.com/notes/toni-diamond/have-you-wanted-to-adopt-but-felt-concerned-that-it-might-be-a-dog-that-didnt-fi/10157161089056634/

When your application is received we process by reviewing all references and then setting up your conference or meeting with the foster family after those references have been checked. Because our foster families volunteer to open their hearts and homes to our rescues, we try to lessen the amount of interference with their lives by only allowing pre-approved adopters to meet the dog and/or call the foster family to ask questions about the dog. The pre-approval process does not obligate you and would NOT require a home visit until you have spoken with or met with the foster family to be sure the dog is right for you. Once that occurs and you are committed to adopting our rescue, then we will schedule your home visit. 

PLEASE NOTE: SOME DOGS MAY NOT BE AVAILABLE FOR A MEET AND GREET. Because we are a foster based rescue, our rescues are transported to our foster families AFTER they have been vetted and are cleared for transport medically. Although our company has headquarters in New Jersey and our second location in Mass, where they end up being fostered depends on which foster is available at that time (our pet finder site only allows us to post in New Jersey or Mass, not where dogs are fostered). Our foster team members are located from North Carolina all the way to Southern Maine. IF THEY ARE BEING FOSTERED OUTSIDE OF THE AREA THAT YOU COULD EASILY TRAVEL TO, we arrange for you to speak with the foster to determine if the dog is what you are expecting. So, if the dogs are not being fostered close enough to visit prior to adoption and this is not acceptable to you, please do not fill out an application. 

In many cases our rescues are adopted directly from their vetting and quarantine and do not even get to foster. Many families are comfortable for a direct adoption, especially with puppies or with the evaluation provided by our references and our rescue trainer. In this case they are transported to the adopter and our adoption contract provides for a thirty day refund of your adoption fee for any reason. The dog is returned to us if they are not working and it cannot be resolved to yours and to our satisfaction. 

From this point, with all information on the application being acceptable and the home visit satisfactory, the applicant is approved and the adoption takes place. Your contracts are emailed and your adoption fee will be $350 (that includes all medical and transport fees). Once contracts are signed and your adoption fee paid, arrangements are made to transport the dog to his/her home, whether it be from a foster or from our vet clinic. 

Beyond the thirty day refund policy in our adoption contract, Diamond Dogs Rescue, Inc. offers a lifetime guarantee on all of its animals. If for any reason an owner needs to return the adopted dog, Diamond Dogs Rescue, Inc. always welcomes the pooch's return and your contract will provide for this

name: Dyson
description:
The same old story....four puppies turned into a kill shelter and their time was up.  How does this even happen to sweet little puppies who should know nothing about the inside of a kill shelter?   How does it happen that no one has adopted them?  Consider this happens so frequently that the \"demand\" for sweet retriever puppies is far less than the puppies who find themselves in this situation.  

Our rescue had a home for one of the puppies, but our policy is to never leave any pups in a litter behind.....so our family grew by four and we absolutely adore these pups.  They began their tenure in foster as shy mistrusting pups but it did not take long for their beautiful personalities to shine.  They are happy, healthy, playful and smart babies!  Just waiting for a family to call their own!

name: Coco
description:
Surrendered to a kill shelter by owners, Coco was considered by all who knew her as a worthy save.  When our rescue was reached out to take her, we did not hesitate given her temperament evaluation.
Her birthdate is 3/9/16.
Weight is 55 pounds
HER FOSTER MOM REPORTS:
No health issues and no bad habits that I've seen so far. The shelter paperwork said no small dogs or cats with her. She hurt a small dog at her home about a year ago. The owner said it was an accident. She is curious about my cat but nothing negative so far. The cat has been keeping his distance from her. She is quiet, I've only heard her bark once at the neighbors dog. She's a laid back and loving girl to a fault. She loves people, she will lick your hand and roll over for a belly rub every chance she gets!. I dont have any info as far as children. She is very fearful of men and we're helping her through that now. She walks well on the leash. She gets along great with all our dogs here. She has basic training, house trained and is crate trained. I've let her have free run of the house all day and night and she hasn't made any mistakes. No chewing, no potty mistakes, nothing! I feed her in her crate. When taking a treat from your hand she is oh so careful like a whisper. She absolutely loves to sleep with her person. She stays in her little spot and doesn't crowd. But when you wake up, you can bet she will crawl up to you for a belly rub!

You can learn more about her from her foster family on her own Facebook page at:
https://www.facebook.com/A-rescues-journey-Meet-Coco-II-109731030383217/?modal=admin_todo_tour

name: KENTUCKY DERBY SOCIETY-A KENTUCKY PUP
description:
8/12/19
Meet the Kentucky pups.  This six-pack of Kentucky goodness, actually from North Carolina,  is sure to melt the hearts of any big dog lover.  Solid and hearty, these stocky pups, at three months, weigh 25 lbs and are destined to be good size pups when grown.  Kentucky Derby is a beautiful black lab mix male.  He loves to play but isnât rambunctious.  Heâs an adventurous boy who likes to run for the roses, explore in the yard and snooze at his fosterâs feet.  He has a welcoming wag that greets his people as he waits for a word of praise and is always convinced he's a winner.  Kentucky Derby is working on crate training, house manners and leash skills. name: Pickles
description:
Pickles is a 3-year-old female spayed Carolina Dog mix who weighs about 42lbs. She has big pointy ears and loves to go hiking, jogging, and chase squirrels. She can also be a total couch potato and just sleep next to her human for hours while the TV is on. Pickles loves peanut butter, pancakes, Swiss cheese, and popcorn. She dislikes vegetables, cats, and not being allowed to catch the squirrels. 

Pickles was originally adopted 2 years ago from North Carolina and has been extremely well cared for as her previous owner is a veterinarian. She is in excellent health and she is house-trained, crate-trained, and knows a lot of commands. Pickles can be a bit nervous around new people and new large dogs and takes a little while to come out of her shell, but when she does she is a total joy! Pickles does best with slow, low-energy introductions and sometimes barks nervously at new people who come on a bit too strong. She loves to play and loves small dogs, but can get a bit defensive around large high-energy dogs at first. However, her best friend is a 90lb Great Pyrenees so she definitely can build trust with any dog as long as the introductions go smoothly!

This family is heartbroken that they must rehome Pickles, but due to health reasons of their 2 month child, they have no choice. We are looking for the right home for this special girl - probably one without cats or small children since we cannot vouch for Pickles in those environments since she hasn't had enough exposure. Dogs will be a case by case intro. Just remember she needs calm temperaments in k9 friends.

The OS has generously offered to forward all of Pickles belongings too! We have 3 crates, about 6 months worth of dog food, heartworm/flea and tick preventatives for the year, and all other supplies she would need!

name: Huckleberry (NC)
description:
My name is Huck and Iâm looking for my forever family... could it be you?

    Iâm about a big, handsome, 3 year old lemon boy, and FULL of life! I was found as a stray and saved from the Georgia shelter before coming to my foster family in North Carolina. They got me some good food and a doctor of my own, and Iâm almost ready to start the next (and best) chapter of my life! My doctor is taking care of my heart worms and I will finish treatment and be ready to go to my new family in mid-September. 

    My favorite things are food, playing with my ball in the yard, playing with my foster brothers, snacks, running in the yard, and eating. Did I mention playing and eating?!

    My ideal family would spend time running and playing with me, and maybe has a human or dog friend, too! Initially, I was evaluated as not being good with cats, but I donât pay my foster-cat-brother any attention at all. I really hate thunder storms, but my parents have some medicine that helps me not be as scared. I donât really love taking baths, but Iâm told they have to be done.

    If you think I may be the one for you, just let PRO know! My foster parents would love to get to know you!


Want to learn more about one of the dogs we have up for adoption? Fill out our adoption application !!

name: Joseph
description: Hey there, my name is Joseph and I'm two years old. I came from a shelter in North Carolina where there was a good chance I was going to be put to sleep because they were very crowded and I tested positive for heartworms. Lucky for me a very nice lady sent my foster mom a picture of me and she fell in love with not only me, but my name. She called the very nice lady in NC and she arranged transport to bring me to GA. Once I settled in to my foster home, mom took me and had me treated for heartworms and I'm doing really great now!!  I'm crate, house trained, a really good boy and I love following mom around the yard when we're all out there together. I also love running around the yard with my doggie friends now AND as you can see from some of my pictures, I kinda love rolling in the dirt but I do it because it gets my doggie friend's attention and they play with me!! lol I never really was like that before I came to my foster mom's house. Now I have a happy, healthy and loving life. BUT,the next thing is, as much as I love my foster mom for the dog that I've become, I would love nothing more than a family or special someone to call my own. It might take me a little bit of time to get used to another home but I will do everything to show what a good boy I am and why my foster mom loves me so much!! She always leans down to me and says \"give mama a kiss\" and she takes my muzzle gives me a kiss on it! lol I really enjoy running now and would make a wonderful companion for that special someone looking for a very handsome, great boy like me who has learned so much since I've been with my foster mom. If you are interested in me, please email my foster mom at lizziz101@bellsouth.net P.S. I really like going for rides now and mom has started taking me to Pet Smart. And I do pretty good there too:)

name: Bayne
description:
Bayne is a gorgeous 2-year-old Treeing Walker Coonhound weighing 60#. Bayne has a lot to smile about since a foster stepped up to save his life from a rural North Carolina shelter.

If you like adventure, Bayne would love to join! This energetic pup loves going on hikes and would also make a great jogging buddy! Bayne enjoys car rides and walks well on a leash.

He is dog and people friendly. Bayne has not been tested with cats, but shows no signs of a high prey drive. He is crate trained and almost housebroken.

description:

RED does not seem to like cats and can be picky about his doggy friends.  He has separation anxiety when he is away from people but we think this may be able to be remedied with a home that has another dog or someone that works from home.  

If you would like more information about RED or to meet him, contact us at (513) 947-2727 or adoption@angelsrestanimalsanctuary.org.

name: Pumpkin
description:
Whose bouncy, pouncy, and tons of fun, Pumpkin is! The wonderful thing about Pumpkin is she's the only one. Yup she is the only one meant just for you. Pumpkin would love to be your one and only has she is a people pleasing dog who loves all people of all ages. She has been around toddlers and older kids which she does great with both. Pumpkin is a Finnish Spitz mix with show stopping orange and red fur. At 2 year old Pumpkin is full

of energy and bounces. But she also has manners with knowing how to sit, stay, lay down, no or leave it, and walks well on her leash. Pumpkin is so smart just tell her to stay beside you while walking and she does. And already potty trained. Pumpkin loves treats and Kongs stuffed with peanut butter.

She would prefer a fenced in yard to run in because she likes her zoom zoom zoomies. Just don't tell her she isn't Tigger because she thinks her springy bounce is fun fun fun.

Pumpkin was from North Carolina as a stray. Though we not sure how long she was a stray but she loves the home life now and going on adventures.

If you think Pumpkin is the perfect match for you please send in adoption adoption application at
https://www.underhoundrailroad.org/adoption/

name: Hazel
description: Hazel is a beautiful girl of under 1.5 years.  She was rescued from a kill shelter in North Carolina.  Hazel is very loving and sweet.  She craves attention.  She is on the smaller side (60-70 lbs).  She is fine with other dogs, and would be good with children.  Hazel probably lived out doors so she will need to learn some indoor manners, but she is a pretty gentle girl, and very smart.  She walks pretty well on a leash, and is eager to please.  We just love her.  She would like an active family.

name: Rookie
description: Rookie is a beautiful dog under 1.5 years old.   He came to us from a shelter in North Carolina.  Rookie was in pretty rough shape when he was brought to the shelter, very underweight and missing some hair...but he has been quickly improving with us!  He is gaining weight, and his coat is coming back - the vet believes it was just allergies.  With a couple of medicated baths, and good food he is looking great.  This dog is absolutely stunning, and will be even handsomer when he gains another 15 lbs or so.  Rookie is super sweet with people, and craves attention.  He is a very active boy.  He has had little training and probably lived outdoors so will need to learn some manners, but he is very smart!  Rookie is good with other dogs upon proper introduction.

name: Lexi

Lexi enjoys the company of other dogs and would do well with another dog in the home. This young girl could fit in pretty much anywhere, send in your application today: https://www.underhoundrailroad.org/adoption/

Lexi is spayed, microchiped and up to date with vaccines. She has tested negative for heartworms.

Please review our application process here: https://www.underhoundrailroad.org/our-adoption-process/

name: Ginger

Giving him all the socialization he needs to come out of his shell. That being said our special boy would do best in a home with another female dog to play with. She is uncomfortable around large animals and livestock, so the farm life is not for her. She is attentive to her person, but also very aware of her surroundings. She is obedient and quick to learn. She's eager to please so she would be a dream to train and teach tricks. 

Could you love a little Snow all year 'round?
