Amelia is being fostered in Clarksburg WV and her adoption fee is 150.00. If you want to give this awesome girl a wonderful loving home...fill out an application at

https://www.pethelpersinc.org/adoption-application/
For more information on this animal email adoptionisforever@pethelpersinc.org.

Pet Helpers is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit foster based volunteer rescue located in Fairmont, WV. We do adopt out of state to approved applicants, if you are willing to drive to WV to pick up your pet. We do not fly or use transport companies. Our adoption fee is $150.00 for mixed breed puppies and adult dogs, $225.00 for full blooded puppies and adult dogs and $50.00 for cats and kittens. Regardless if the animal is a mixed breed or full blooded they are spayed/neutered prior to adoption IF they are old enough. If they are too young at the time of adoption, then it is your financial responsibility to spay/neuter the pet by the age of 6 months and you must provide proof for our files that it has been done. All of our pets are checked by a vet, given the shots appropriate for their age and any other treatment deemed necessary by the vet. All of our pets are adopted as indoor pets and are not be outdoors tied to a box 24/7. The pet you are adopting has been living in a home with a foster family. You are expected to take possession of the pet you are applying for within a few days of application approval. This will enable us to accept another pet into that home. Because we are a rescue, and believe that spaying and neutering is crucial in stopping the reproduction of unwanted puppies/kittens and massive amounts of animals dying daily in shelters across the country, we expect any animal already in your home to be spayed/neutered. If for any reason you are unable to keep the pet you have adopted you are required to return them to Pet Helpers, Inc. They are not to be sold or given away.

Check us out on Facebook!!!!!! We hope you will give us two paws up, like our page and share with your friends. Pet Helpers, Inc.

name: Shiny
description:
Shiny is an approximately 4-6-year-old spayed Bull Breed mix. She came from a shelter in Wyoming, so we dont know anything about her prior history. She is an amazing girl with so many wonderful qualities. But, like all of us, she has some things about her that maybe arent brag-worthy. Well start with the things about Miss Shiny that are awesome. First off, she is a very sweet girl with loads of love to give. She LOVES people! She is a world-class snuggler and could spend the whole day curled up on her persons lap. She loves to burrow herself under blankets. That is her happy place. If you let her sleep underneath the covers, she will be one content little lady and will love you forever. She is very treats motivated and loves her food! Shes been living in her foster home for the past several months with multiple other dogs and has done great. As long as any other dogs shes around arent snappy or aggressive towards her, she makes friends with just about everyone. She is a goofball too. She can be extremely silly and funny and makes her foster family laugh all the time. Dont tell her we told anyone this (shed be so embarrassed), but she has a bit of a gas problem. She can be a motor butt at times, and its always good for a laugh. She loves to roll on the floor on her back and stare at you from upside down. Shes also very vocal when it comes to her disdain for things. When shes not happy, she does these funny grunts that communicate her dislike of a situation. 
None of us are perfect, and that goes for sweet Shiny too. She has a few things about her that need some work or is just things that make her who she is and probably will not change. While Shiny loves being around her dog buddies, that is where her ability to get along with other animals ends. She absolutely CANNOT be in a home with cats, rabbits, birds, guinea pigs, etc. She has far too high of a prey drive to be around small animals. She also is an extreme door darter. She bolts through any open door when given a chance. If its a door to outside the home, once shes out, she will run as fast and far as she can. She will mow over anyone to get out of an open door if she really wants to. Her foster family has been working with her on this issue for quite some time, but because her drive to bolt through doors is so high, they feel that it is something she will probably never really be fully trustworthy with. She, therefore, needs to be in a home without younger children and where doors are secured and opened only when she is safely put away, especially exterior doors where she is not given the opportunity to bolt and run, putting her safety at risk. She absolutely loves her walks and gets very excited to go. She has come a long way on her leash manners over the past few months, but she still needs some work. She doesnt travel great in a car at this point. She gets extremely excited in new situations, and a car ride is like her mind is on overload and she has a hard time not getting overstimulated in the car. Shes made progress, but she does still have a way to go as far as learning to ride calmly in a vehicle. Storms and fireworks are very scary for her. She doesnt understand the loud noises. She gets very stressed in these situations. She will need someone to be patient with her and help her feel as safe and secure when she feels the whole world is coming down. When she feels stressed at all, she has been known to take her stress and frustration out on pillows or dog beds. Shes very sensitive to any tension or anger in the home, and when she feels stressed out from any of these situations, she can be destructive. 
Shiny is an extremely sweet dog with so much potential. She will thrive in a home who can give her the guidance, love, patience, and security she needs and deserves.

If you think you would be good for our Shiny girl please send an email to Celestialzooutah@gmail.com. She is spayed, vaccinated, and microchipped, her adoption fee is $200.

name: Callie
description:
Callie is a 14 year old Chihuahua whose owner died and whose family couldn't keep her permanently. So she made the trip from Cincinnati to Youngstown where she slid into foster home easily.

This girl weighs about 7 1/2 pounds and is fully vetted. She just had a dental so she's much more pleasant to be around. :)  We're really just learning about her.

She's learning to be her foster mom's \"chair Chi\" and is finding her place in the pack. She's a bit nervous and reserved at first, but once she's used to her situation she is a very friendly, sweet girl. She's good with other small dogs and so-so with cats. She would probably prefer a home without a cat, but once properly introduced to one, she should be OK. 

She is crate trained, but during feeding times is very vocal. During that time, she sounds like a wild animal or bird from a jungle. Right before and after feeding you wouldn't think she was a Chihuahua. Other than that, she's pretty good in a crate.

We're working on house training. She will potty outside, but her potty breaks need to be consistent. She loves her basket and blanket, and loves sleeping (like all seniors do!)

Callie would like a quieter household with her own personal human to love and bond with. She's a good little guard Chi who wants a home that she can protect when called upon. She wants regular feeding (and peanut butter snacks!!!) and chair time so she can feel close to her person.

**Callie is being fostered in Youngstown, OH**

Callie's adoption fee is $250. If she sounds like the dog of your dreams please contact Chihuahua Rescue & Transport and she will pack her toys and love and be there in a wag of her tail.

If you would like more information about adopting this dog, please go to our website(www.chihuahua-rescue.org). All dogs listed are adoptable in the 10 Midwestern states(OH/IN/KY/IL/MN/MI/WI/PA/IA/MO). We do transport! All of our dogs are spread out throughout the Midwest in foster homes.

Please fill out an adoption application at: www.tinyurl.com/CRTMidwestApp
